event_summary: TUTAG sit-down strike at Tamale Technical University, May 10–June 2, over allowances and end-of-service formula; June 2 source reports settlement.
exclusion_reason: Reviewed bodies describe a service withdrawal and negotiations with university management. They do not establish a public protest by teachers or a demand on Ghanaian government/state policy. Students’ separate May 10 gathering remains candidate GHA23MAY-E004; do not merge the actions.

date.summary: Strike began May 10 and was called off June 2 after management settlement.

demand_target.summary: Allowances/end-of-service formula negotiated with university management; state-policy demand not established.

public_action.summary: Teacher press conference/work withdrawal documented; no teacher public rally, picket or assembly described.
